import_provenance.original_statement: Is the monad of all continuous valuations on dcpos commutative: can the order of two independent probabilistic computations always be exchanged? Goubault-Larrecq’s semantics obtains this property for minimal valuations, but the full continuous-valuation monad remains the open target.
